description: This file exports functions to load include patterns from environment variables and to create a scoped Vitest configuration specific to an IRC extension, culminating in exporting a default configuration instance.

methods.name: export function loadIncludePatternsFromEnv( loadIncludePatternsFromEnv
methods.description: Loads inclusion patterns from environment variables, defaulting to process.env if no env object is provided.

methods.name: export function createExtensionIrcVitestConfig( createExtensionIrcVitestConfig
methods.description: Creates a scoped Vitest configuration for the IRC extension, using include patterns from environment or default roots, and setting specific configuration options.
